unit.why: A halakhic-kabbalistic note on removing tefillin during a circumcision. It is supported by the author's eyewitness reports of the customs of R. Meir of Lublin and R. Moshe Yehuda Leib of Sasov. These describe habitual practice, not a narrated event, so there is no story.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a run of tefillin-custom excerpts from several books; the previous and next divisions are similar sayings.
